newsitem.title: UK: Russia to export 2.8 mln tonnes Black Sea crude July.
newsitem.headline: Russia to export 2.8 mln tonnes Black Sea crude July.

text.p: Russia will export 2.8 million tonnes of crude oil from the Black Sea port of Novorissiisk in July, official figures received by traders showed.
Other Russian figures received by Western companies forecast exports of 25.5 million tonnes of crude from all former Soviet Union ports and pipelines in the third quarter of 1997.

The loading programme for Novorissiisk was made up of 15 cargoes of more than 120,000 tonnes, including one for the dates June 30-July 1, eight cargoes of close to 80,000 tonnes and seven smaller cargoes.
Comparative figures for June were not immediately available but the Novorissiisk programme in May totalled 2.7 million tonnes.
"I think these figures are broadly in line with previous months," said a trade source, warning that weather and technical problems frequently interrupt crude flows out of the Black Sea port.
